mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 77 degrees and clear at Harriet Park. We have an air quality alert with an index of 53, and tonight we expect a low of 68 degrees with no rain in the forecast under a waning crescent moon.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is promoting their tri-shaw bike program, which provides free, scenic rides for residents along the Military Ridge State Trail. Additionally, the Recreation Department is seeking seasonal staff, including adult fitness instructors.
There is plenty to do! Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or head to the Verona Ice Arena for the Girls Try Hockey event. Tomorrow, consider checking out yoga at Insight Wellness.
Regarding the weekly police report, on Thursday, a driver was stopped for equipment violations and subsequently arrested for O W I.
Culver's of Verona is serving up Snickers Swirl today and will remain open until 10 PM. Stop by soon to enjoy this delicious flavor!
